title: Eight-Channel Electronic-Nose Data and Code for Duplicate-Aware Ordered Mixture Screening
description: Raw electronic-nose measurements (550 files, 11 composition labels), selected normalized eight-channel responses (350 sources, 348 file/byte-duplicate groups), nested grouped classification code and reference results, and integer/RTL inference reference packages for ordered Danggui–Duhuo mixture screening. Code is MIT licensed; data and documentation are CC BY 4.0.
